name: Ring of Inspired Performance, Improved
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 10th; Slot ring; Price 10,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As a ring of inspired performance, except it grants the wearer a +10 competence bonus to any Perform skill check.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring, Perform 10 ranks, ring of at least 500 gp in value; Cost 5,000 gp

Identification DC 25
